test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Graduate Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She faced a __session of abuse__ after insisting that she was too beautiful to be liked.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"tirade"** means a long, angry speech of criticism or accusation. (आलोचनात्मक भाषण)

 
 
• **Example: **The manager launched into a** tirade** about the poor performance of the team.
 
 
 
• **"Abuse"** refers to the use of something to bad effect or for a bad purpose; misuse. It can also mean cruel and violent treatment of a person or animal. (दुरुपयोग, दुर्व्यवहार)
 
 
• **Example: **She suffered years of physical** abuse **at the hands of her husband.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that** "tirade of abuse" **is the correct substitution as it accurately describes a long, angry speech filled with abusive language.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Recital of abuse** (दुर्व्यवहार का वाचन): A recital is the action of reading something aloud.

 
 
• **Example:** The** recital of abuse** during the meeting was shocking to everyone present.
 
 
 
• **Declamation of abuse** (दुर्व्यवहार का जोरदार भाषण): Declamation refers to a forceful or emotional speech.
 
 
• **Example: **His **declamation of abuse** left the audience in stunned silence.
 
 
 
• **Recitation of abuse** (दुर्व्यवहार का पाठ): Recitation is the action of repeating something aloud from memory.
 
 
• **Example:** The** recitation of abuse** was so intense that it brought tears to her eyes.
 
 

 

15f:Tb9f,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
